# Kid Genius World

Canonical URL: https://kid-genius-world.com
Domain: kid-genius-world.com
Last updated: 2026-07-11

## Summary
Kid Genius World is a parent-guided AI school experience and online learning app for kids with reading, math, science, coding, stories, games, and parent progress tools. It is not accredited, not a real school, and does not issue grades, credits, diplomas, or transcripts.
